Phase 53 plan (docs/phases/legacy-diagnostics.md, commit on branch phase/legacy-diagnostics). One read-only report, `tagteam doctor [DIR] [--json]`, in new tagteam/diagnostics.py:
1. Legacy workflow findings: scans project .claude/skills, .claude/commands, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (Phase 52 managed paths excluded — framework section only). Rules table: retired-command (/handoff-* family, ai_handoff), fixed-role (only when it contradicts tagteam.yaml; matching = info), legacy-skill-shape (retired name AND content evidence). Name or provider mention alone is never a finding. All findings are 'candidate, no provenance'; remediation is prose, no delete commands. User-level: Phase 49 candidates by path, never read.
2. Capability/context visibility: per-role launch executable (shutil.which), contract entry points + plugin status (existing plugin list call), instruction sources and what each provider auto-loads vs headless injects/truncates (reuses headless.py), tool config names only (.mcp.json server names, settings hook events, .codex/config.toml presence), protection-scope notes. States: configured/found/missing/unknown; no probing, no secret values.
3. setup/upgrade (incl. preview) print one pointer line when findings exist; exit codes unchanged. doctor exits 0 with findings, 2 on bad target; added to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS.
4. Capability documentation is prose guidance in data/workflows.md, no new yaml schema.
Review focus: rule false positives, new 'doctor' command vs extending 'state diagnose', prose-not-schema for capabilities. Also on this branch: e712952 commits the pending role swap back to Claude lead / Codex reviewer, role-neutral local templates and AGENTS.md pointer (arbiter request). Plan round: document checks only, no suite run.

The bounded doctor command and prose capability guidance fit Phase 53; no objection to either design choice. Please resolve these report-contract issues before implementation:

1. Define a safe output boundary instead of directly reusing onboarding.describe_roles. That function prints the entire configured launch command (tagteam/onboarding.py), contradicting this plan's promise that args and secret values are never printed. Specify structured role data with only the name, provider and executable, with command arguments omitted in both text and JSON. Also make the no-link-following, regular-file and bounded-read policy apply to capability config reads (.mcp.json and Claude settings), not only the legacy Markdown scan: a project config symlink can otherwise cause a user-home credential file to be read. Add fixtures with a launch argument containing a sentinel secret, symlinked config files/parents, malformed config and non-regular files; reporting must omit secrets, skip unsupported reads and keep producing a report. Narrow the literal 'never reads a secret' wording to the actual guarantee: parsing a config containing env values necessarily reads those bytes even if only names are extracted.

2. Specify capability status independently from the existing plugin readiness boolean. plugin_status deliberately maps missing CLI, timeout, malformed output and ambiguous records to installed=False, and version_line renders all of those as 'not installed'. That is suitable for fallback selection but does not establish absence. Doctor should report plugin availability as unknown when discovery is unavailable or fails, and distinguish that from confirmed absence/disabled/broken installation, preserving the reason. Add missing-CLI, timeout and malformed-output fixtures alongside confirmed absence/presence. The existing plugin discovery behavior need not change; adapt it for this report.

3. Define separate desktop launch and headless provider/executable observations. The plan checks only argv0 of the launch command, but agents.<role>.headless.provider and .executable can override it (config.get_headless_spec/infer_headless_provider). Use the actual headless resolution for injected-context claims; do not infer provider from display name or present one executable check as covering both modes. Add a custom display-name fixture with differing desktop and headless configuration and verify the report identifies which observations/context behavior belong to each mode.

Reviewed the plan, source recommendation and referenced helpers. Document/source inspection only; no test suite run for this plan review.

Round 2 plan revision (985d1d6, docs/phases/legacy-diagnostics.md; revision log at the end). All three findings addressed:
1. Output boundary: doctor no longer uses describe_roles; structured role data only — launch first token basename + resolved path, NAME=value or unsplittable command -> unknown with nothing echoed; no command args/headless.args/env/headers in text or JSON. One shape-checked bounded reader (Phase 52 lstat rules, root-down components) for every file, including .mcp.json and .claude/settings*.json: symlinked file or parent, directory, FIFO -> unsupported, never opened; JSON >64KB skipped; malformed/wrong type -> unknown, report continues. 'Never reads a secret' narrowed to an output guarantee. Fixtures: sentinels in launch args, NAME= prefix, headless.args, .mcp.json env/headers; symlinks to a fake-home sentinel file, symlinked .claude/, directories, FIFO (non-blocking), oversize, malformed, wrong-type JSON.
2. Plugin availability classified by doctor from list_plugins: no records (missing CLI/timeout/non-zero/malformed) -> unknown(reason); no applicable record -> missing; disabled -> configured, disabled; no skill/installPath -> configured, broken; unsupported scope/disagreement -> unknown; enabled+skill -> found. plugin_status and fallback selection unchanged (asserted on the same fixtures). Framework line no longer uses version_line's 'not installed' wording.
3. Desktop and headless observed as separate rows/JSON objects: desktop from the launch command; headless from get_headless_spec/infer_headless_provider with provider source label (explicit/inferred from command/inferred from name/unresolved) and headless.executable checked separately. Auto-load (desktop) and injection/truncation (headless) claims keyed to each mode's provider. Fixture: display name Architect, command 'claude --model x', headless provider codex + executable /opt/fake/codex; plus a name-only agent.
Document checks only; no suite run for the plan round.

Approved the revised Phase 53 plan at 985d1d6. All three round-1 findings are addressed: structured output omits launch/headless arguments and sensitive configuration fields, config inspection uses bounded reads with filesystem-shape checks; plugin discovery failures are unknown rather than confirmed absence without changing fallback behavior; desktop and headless executable/provider/context observations are separate and use the existing headless resolution. The added fixtures cover the requested cases. The report-only doctor command, setup/upgrade pointer and prose capability guidance remain appropriately scoped. Reviewed the full revised plan, revision diff and configuration helpers; document/source inspection only, no suite run for this plan review. Proceed to implementation under the approved plan and use the on-submit gate for the recorded full-suite run.
